policy.benchmark_transfer: Prices outside RunPod are projections using measured RunPod TPS, not measurements on the quoted provider.
excluded_costs: persistent storage unless inseparable from the instance
policy.vast_quote_rule: Median of the three cheapest verified, rentable, single-GPU, on-demand offers with reliability >=0.98, CUDA >=12.8, and VRAM matching the measured SKU.
policy.warning: Provider products differ in CPU, RAM, storage, networking, availability, tenancy, and minimum rental commitment.

notes: Rates are on-demand Pod compute prices and can change.
Storage, setup time, idle time, data preparation, checkpoint I/O, and taxes are excluded.
Community and Secure Cloud prices are retained separately.
The benchmark is single-GPU; prices do not imply multi-GPU scaling efficiency.
